business_model.basis: Stated directly in the 10-K Item 1 Business section.
business_model.claim: Versant operates in four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf and athletics participation, and sports and genre entertainment, serving viewing audiences, paying subscribers, advertisers, distributors, and licensing counterparties.
quotes: Versant is a media and entertainment business that operates in four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf and athletics participation and sports and genre entertainment.

We produce, license and acquire content that we distribute through a variety of outlets, including our networks and digital platforms, delivering value to key constituents: the viewing audience, paying subscribers, advertisers, distributors and licensing counterparties.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in the 10-K Item 1 Business section.
business_model.claim: Versant generates revenue through four streams: linear distribution to MVPDs, advertising on networks and digital platforms, services through digital platforms (GolfNow, Fandango, SportsEngine), and content licensing to third parties.
quotes: We generate revenue primarily through distributing our networks, selling advertising across our brands, providing services through our digital platforms and content licensing.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in the 10-K Item 1 Business section.
business_model.claim: Versant presents its operations in one reportable business segment.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K and 10-Q MD&A; the (6.8)% figure is from the 10-Q revenue table (table in millions).
business_model.claim: Linear distribution revenue is based on subscriber count multiplied by a per-subscriber fee paid by MVPDs, and declined (6.8)% for the six months ended June 30, 2026, driven by continued subscriber declines partially offset by contractual rate increases.
quotes: Our revenue from distribution agreements is generally based on the number of subscribers receiving our television networks through the provider and a per subscriber fee.

Linear distribution revenue decreased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to continued declines in subscribers, which were partially offset by contractual rate increases.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K and 10-Q MD&A; the (0.6)% figure is from the 10-Q revenue table (table in millions).
business_model.claim: Advertising revenue is priced based on audience ratings, viewer targeting capabilities, quality of programming, and the number of advertising units available, and decreased (0.6)% for the three months ended June 30, 2026, with network ratings declines partially offset by incremental revenue from a new acquisition.
quotes: The price charged for each advertising unit on our networks is generally based on audience ratings, the value of our audiences to advertisers, the quality of our programming and brand building capabilities, any viewer targeting and addressability capabilities and the number of advertising units we can place in our networks' programming schedules.

Advertising revenue decreased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, as decreases at our networks were partially offset by incremental revenue from a new acquisition.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K and 10-Q MD&A; the 4.8% figure is from the 10-Q revenue table (table in millions).
business_model.claim: Platforms revenue is transaction-based, consisting of an agreed share of underlying transaction value, consumer-paid fees, or fixed per-transaction amounts, and grew 4.8% for the six months ended June 30, 2026, driven by increases at Fandango and GolfNow.
quotes: Our revenue related to these platforms is generally transaction-based, and depending on the service, generally consists of an agreed share based on the value of underlying transactions, transaction-based fees paid by the consumer or fixed amounts for individual transactions or services provided.
Platforms revenue increased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to increases at Fandango and GolfNow.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-Q MD&A; the 63.4% figure is from the 10-Q revenue table (table in millions).
business_model.claim: Content licensing and other revenue comes from licensing owned content to third-party networks, streaming services, and digital platforms, and increased 63.4% for the six months ended June 30, 2026, primarily due to a large licensing agreement recognized in the first quarter of 2026.
quotes: Content licensing and other revenue consists of revenue generated from licensing our owned content to third parties, including television networks, streaming services and other platforms, licensing audio feeds of our programming and audio content to digital platforms.

Content licensing and other revenue was constant for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and increased for the six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year period, primarily due to the impact of a large licensing agreement recognized during the first quarter of 2026.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K MD&A operating results narrative.
business_model.claim: Versant's key structural revenue headwinds are ongoing MVPD subscriber declines (8% in both 2025 and 2024) and network ratings declines (17% in 2025), while its key growth driver is the expansion of digital platforms.
quotes: Linear distribution revenue decreased in 2025 and 2024, primarily due to declines in the number of subscribers of 8% in each of these periods, respectively, partially offset by contractual rate increases.

Advertising revenue decreased in 2025 and 2024, as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to decreases at our networks as a result of ratings declines of 17% and 8%, respectively.
Our revenue from our digital platforms has grown in recent years, and we expect that it will continue to grow as we invest in this growing portion of our business.

Platforms revenue increased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to increases at Fandango and GolfNow.

quotes: Through Versant's programming and brands, we plan to expand our audience reach through digital platforms such as advertising-based video on demand ("AVOD"), subscription video on demand ("SVOD") and FAST, as well as other distribution methods, including OTA and live events.

Linear distribution revenue decreased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to continued declines in subscribers, which were partially offset by contractual rate increases.

material_events.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1) and P3 (10-K MD&A)
material_events.claim: Versant separated from Comcast and became a standalone publicly traded company; Class A common stock began trading on Nasdaq under ticker VSNT on January 5, 2026.
quotes: On January 2, 2026, we separated (the "Separation") from Comcast and became a standalone publicly traded company and on January 5, 2026, Versant's Class A common stock began trading under the ticker symbol "VSNT" on the Nasdaq Global Select Market LLC ("Nasdaq").

On January 2, 2026, the Separation of Versant from Comcast was completed through the distribution of 100% of the shares of Versant Class A common stock and Versant Class B common stock (together, the "common stock") to holders of Comcast Class A common stock and Comcast Class B common stock as of the close of business on the record date of December 16, 2025.

material_events.claim: Versant announced it entered into a stock purchase agreement to acquire all equity interests of Full Swing Golf Holdings, Inc. for an aggregate purchase price of $530,000,000, subject to customary adjustments.
quotes: On July 6, 2026, Versant Media Group, Inc. ("Versant") issued a press release announcing that it entered into a stock purchase agreement with Full Swing Golf Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company") and FSG MidCo, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Seller"), pursuant to which, among other things, the Company agreed to acquire all of the equity interests of the Company from the Seller for an aggregate purchase price of $530,000,000, subject to customary adjustments (the "Transaction").

risks.basis: Stated directly in P3 and P4; subscriber decline figures and forward-looking expectation are explicit management disclosures
risks.claim: Linear distribution revenue, the largest revenue line at $4,092 (table in millions) in 2025, is in structural decline with subscriber losses of 8% per year and a further (6.3)% drop in Q2 2026, and management states it expects continued declines.
quotes: Linear distribution revenue decreased in 2025 and 2024, primarily due to declines in the number of subscribers of 8% in each of these periods, respectively, partially offset by contractual rate increases.
We expect to experience continued declines in the number of subscribers and linear distribution revenue, as further discussed in "Key Factors Affecting Our Business."

risks.basis: Stated in P3 and P4; ratings decline percentages and forward-looking language are explicit
risks.claim: Advertising revenue, at $1,577 (table in millions) in 2025, declined 8.9% in 2025 and 7.2% in 2024 driven by ratings declines of 17% and 8% respectively, and management warns of continued future declines.
quotes: Advertising revenue decreased in 2025 and 2024, as compared to the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to decreases at our networks as a result of ratings declines of 17% and 8%, respectively.
We may experience declines in advertising revenues in future periods as a result of the trends discussed in "Key Factors Affecting Our Business."

risks.basis: Stated as a risk factor in P2 (10-K Item 1A); the specific counter-evidence of renewals is from P6
risks.claim: Post-Separation, Versant's negotiating position with MVPDs is weakened because it can no longer bundle its programming with NBCU's broadcast networks, Bravo, and Peacock, creating risk that distribution agreements will not renew on comparable terms.
quotes: As a result of the Separation, our negotiating position with MVPDs may be weakened without the ability to sell our programming along with NBCU's broadcast television networks, the Bravo cable network and Peacock.
There can be no assurance that any of our programming distribution agreements will be entered into or renewed in the future on similar terms.

risks.basis: Stated in P1 (rights table) and P2 (risk factor); the competitive-cost trend is explicitly described in both
risks.claim: Sports programming rights have become significantly more competitive and expensive, and there is no assurance existing agreements will renew at attractive rates; Versant's key rights (Premier League, WWE, WNBA, NASCAR, PGA Tour) expire between 2027 and 2036, creating a multi-year renewal window where costs could escalate.
quotes: Sports programming, in particular, has become significantly more competitive and expensive in recent years.
there can be no assurance that we will be able to renew our existing sports programming agreements at attractive rates, or at all.

risks.basis: Stated in P2 risk factors and P3 MD&A; the structural nature and irreversibility are explicitly acknowledged by management
risks.claim: Structural consumer migration away from MVPD cable subscriptions toward streaming, social media, and direct-to-consumer platforms is a stated, ongoing headwind that reduces both subscriber counts and advertising value, and the company acknowledges it cannot be certain how consumer demand will evolve.
quotes: Technological advances and evolving consumer preferences have changed how audiences consume video content, reducing the number of subscribers to MVPDs and, in turn, adversely affecting businesses like ours that derive distribution revenue from MVPDs.
we expect subscribers to continue to depart the MVPD ecosystem, we cannot be certain how consumer demand will evolve in the future.
